runs.label: exploratory_prepublication
runs.notes: Completed before source publication and before independent review finished. Original raw output preserved. Subsequent review added response validation and failure-evidence retention; not an unchanged-protocol replicate.

runs.label: postpublication_amended_protocol_repeat

interpretation: Two same-host executions, not independent hardware trials or a powered confirmatory study. Shared-host contention may differ between runs.
